scripts.deploy: astro build && node scripts/keep-previous-assets.mjs default && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:check-main: [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] && git checkout main && git fetch -q origin main && [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" ] || { echo 'Aborting: uncommitted changes or main not in sync with remote. Commit/push first.'; exit 1; }
scripts.deploy:tt02: pnpm run deploy:check-main && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=tt02 astro build && node scripts/keep-previous-assets.mjs tt02 && wrangler deploy --env tt02
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm run deploy:check-main && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=prod astro build && node scripts/keep-previous-assets.mjs prod && wrangler deploy --env prod
scripts.deploy:tt02:preview: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=tt02 astro build && node scripts/keep-previous-assets.mjs tt02 && wrangler deploy --env tt02
